blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
Previously, we built your portfolio together using HTML and CSS. Does it look the way you imagined? Complete. Structured. Styled.
But it does not react yet. No clicks. No movement. No feedback.
In this course, you will use JavaScript to add that missing piece. The part that makes your website respond.

blocks.alt: HTML, CSS, and JS working together

blocks.content: JavaScript is what makes websites respond.

Imagine you walk into a room. The furniture is there. The lights are off. Nothing moves. That is your website without JavaScript. Someone flips a switch — the lights come on, the door opens. That switch is JavaScript.
It expands menus, switches to dark mode, and processes what you type. It wakes your website up
What you will build in this course
By the end, your portfolio will not just look complete. It will feel complete. It will click, respond, and react the way a real website should.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
